title: Immediate rejection at the altar
hook: The groom rejects Juliana within the opening seconds.
cliffhanger: Her appeal to her father remains unanswered.
rationale: Excellent standalone betrayal and fast hook.

title: Father disowns his daughter
hook: Father threatens to strip Juliana of her family name.
cliffhanger: A new threat emerges concerning her mother’s ledger.
rationale: Clear emotional injustice with an additional story question.

title: Accused of witchcraft
hook: The judge announces witchcraft, unlawful healing and poisoning charges.
cliffhanger: Juliana refuses to deny possessing and using the book.
rationale: Instantly understandable high-stakes trial.
review_note: Ending is defiant, not a pure cliffhanger

title: Execution in two days
hook: Alexander confronts his mother about Juliana’s arrest.
cliffhanger: She reveals the execution will follow a wedding in two days.
rationale: Urgent deadline and compelling rescue question.

title: Guards refuse to arrest the stranger
hook: Alexander enters the cathedral amid confrontation.
cliffhanger: A guard reveals that they know who Alexander is.
rationale: Strong secret-identity cliffhanger and dramatic reversal.

title: A healer faces the gallows
hook: Catherine recognizes and humiliates Juliana.
cliffhanger: She threatens to use the herbal book to have her hanged.
rationale: Clear villain, escalating danger, consequential final threat.

title: Husband threatened with hanging
hook: Clarissa immediately threatens to hang Juliana’s husband.
cliffhanger: Juliana demands to know where the garden is.
rationale: Exceptional first-line threat and urgent dilemma.
review_note: Ending is a decision, not an unresolved reveal

title: The hidden poison is discovered
hook: A medical mystery is investigated.
cliffhanger: Juliana says she can try to save the victim.
rationale: Clear poisoning reveal, strong medical jeopardy.
review_note: Opening is mild; consider tighter cut

title: A plot to frame the healer
hook: Rupert fears the captive woman may speak.
cliffhanger: The villains outline the fabricated evidence against her.
rationale: Antagonist conspiracy with impending danger.
review_note: Ends on exposition; test tighter endpoint

title: Alexander survived a planned ambush
hook: Alexander’s mother asks about a traitor.
cliffhanger: Alexander says he spent three years seeking who betrayed him.
rationale: Compelling backstory and mystery of a presumed-dead man.

title: The buried duke returns
hook: A covert operation approaches the estate.
cliffhanger: Alexander declares the supposedly dead man has returned.
rationale: Strong identity-reveal arc and impending confrontation.

title: Who sent the attackers?
hook: Alexander shields Juliana from armed attackers.
cliffhanger: He demands the identity of the person behind the ambush.
rationale: Immediate physical danger and a clear unresolved question.

title: Forced search for her husband’s freedom
hook: Juliana suffers through a coerced search while her husband pleads.
cliffhanger: Her cry of pain ends the sequence.
rationale: Intense physical jeopardy and emotional cruelty.
review_note: Opening is weak; inspect footage carefully

title: A planted watch exposes a trap
hook: A constable searches Alexander’s coat.
cliffhanger: A watch appears as Gerald celebrates the discovery.
rationale: Strong visual evidence reveal and apparent frame-up.
review_note: Needs context for significance of watch

title: The stranger proposes marriage
hook: The stranger offers Juliana a ring.
cliffhanger: He asks her to accept his hand before her answer.
rationale: Clean romantic cliffhanger and character-driven curiosity.

title: The would-be duchess confronts him
hook: Catherine challenges Alexander over their past.
cliffhanger: She reacts in disbelief to his choice of Juliana.
rationale: Romantic rivalry with an unresolved reaction.

title: A secret marriage is revealed
hook: Juliana and Alexander affirm their love.
cliffhanger: Alexander begins asserting the validity of their marriage.
rationale: Emotional relationship payoff with a reveal.
review_note: Ends mid-sentence; cut must be checked

title: Juliana confronts the aristocracy
hook: Catherine dismisses Juliana’s husband as a nobody.
cliffhanger: Catherine loses control as Juliana challenges her values.
rationale: Powerful self-worth speech with clear emotional conflict.

title: Who hurt Juliana?
hook: Alexander discovers Juliana has been injured.
cliffhanger: He presses her to identify whom she went to help.
rationale: Visible injury plus hidden-mission mystery.
review_note: Last beat is a question, but context matters

title: A mother begs to save her child
hook: Alexander prepares to answer an urgent knock.
cliffhanger: A mother begs Juliana to save her feverish boy.
rationale: Distinct healing/rescue stakes rather than repeated palace conflict.
review_note: Opening is slower; footage validation required
